block.comment: Purpose: Start a nonblocking buzzer note while the rest of loop can keep working. Hardware: use Connections to check pin ownership for your selected board. Open the comment bubbles on the main steps for explanations.
Runs once after power-on or reset. Initialise the program here; repeating measurements and animation belong in loop.
Drive this output LOW or HIGH. This controls the connected digital signal; it does not produce a variable analog voltage.
Repeats until power is removed. Each block runs in order, then execution returns to the top. Keep this loop responsive when servicing motors, music or serial input.
